description: Headline figures for the job market in Finland from the JobCrawls Data Desk: open job ads now, the shares that are remote, hybrid and on-site, the share that state pay, and open and remote ads in the largest cities, with the date the counts were taken. Fits "how many jobs are open in Finland" or "how common is remote work in Finland". Pay by role comes from pay_for_role and the pay transparency trend from get_pay_transparency. The figures are free to reuse, including commercially, with a visible link to jobcrawls.com. Reuse: figures may be quoted with a visible link to the jobcrawls.com page in the result (or "JobCrawls (jobcrawls.com)" where a link is impossible); each result repeats this in dataUse.

city.description: Limit the city figures to one city (Helsinki, Espoo, Tampere, Vantaa, Oulu, Turku, Jyväskylä). Omit for all.
